title: Number of tests
subTitle: last month
sqlForIndicator: select sum(f.resultCount) as cnt from FactResultCountDevice as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where assayId is null and resultCategory1 is null and f.days = 30

title: Successful Tests
subTitle: last month
sqlForIndicator: select sum(f.resultCount) as cnt from FactResultCountDevice as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where  resultCategory1 not in (5,6,7) and f.days = 30

title: Failed Test Rate
subTitle: last month
sqlForIndicator: select concat(round(sum(case when f.resultCategory1 in (5,6,7) then f.resultCount else 0 end)/sum(case when f.assayId is null and f.resultCategory1 is null then f.resultCount else 0 end)*100,2),'%') as cnt from FactResultCountDevice as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId  inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where f.days = 30

title: Failed Tests
subTitle: trend this vs last month
sqlForIndicator: select concat(case when (sum(case when f.days=30 and f.resultCategory1 in (5,6,7) then f.resultCount else 0 end)/sum(case when f.days=30 and f.assayId is null and f.resultCategory1 is null then f.resultCount else 0 end)>(sum(case when f.days=60 and f.resultCategory1 in (5,6,7) then f.resultCount else 0 end)-sum(case when f.days=30 and f.resultCategory1 in (5,6,7) then f.resultCount else 0 end))/(sum(case when f.days=60 and f.assayId is null and f.resultCategory1 is null then f.resultCount else 0 end)-sum(case when f.days=30 and f.assayId is null and f.resultCategory1 is null then f.resultCount else 0 end))) then '+' else '' end, round((sum(case when f.days=30 and f.resultCategory1 in (5,6,7) then f.resultCount else 0 end)/sum(case when f.days=30 and f.assayId is null and f.resultCategory1 is null then f.resultCount else 0 end)-(sum(case when f.days=60 and f.resultCategory1 in (5,6,7) then f.resultCount else 0 end)-sum(case when f.days=30 and f.resultCategory1 in (5,6,7) then f.resultCount else 0 end))/(sum(case when f.days=60 and f.assayId is null and f.resultCategory1 is null then f.resultCount else 0 end)-sum(case when f.days=30 and f.assayId is null and f.resultCategory1 is null then f.resultCount else 0 end)))*100,2),'%') as cnt from FactResultCountDevice as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id

title: MTB+
subTitle: last month
sqlForIndicator: select sum(f.resultCount) as cnt from FactResultCountDevice as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where f.resultCategory1=1 and f.assayId in (1,2) and f.days = 30

title: MTB+ Rif+
subTitle: last month
sqlForIndicator: select count(r.id) as cnt from Result as r inner join Device as d on d.id = r.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where resultCategory1=1 and resultCategory2=1 and r.endedOn > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)

title: MTB+ Rif?
subTitle: last month
sqlForIndicator: select concat(round(sum(case when resultCategory1=1 and resultCategory2=4 then 1 else 0 end)/count(r.id)*100,2),'%') as cnt from Result as r inner join Device as d on d.id = r.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where r.endedOn > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day)

title: MTB+ Rif?
subTitle: trend this vs last month
sqlForIndicator: select concat(case when (sum(case when r.endedOn > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) and r.resultCategory1=1 and r.resultCategory2=4 then 1 else 0 end)/sum(case when r.endedOn > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) then 1 else 0 end))>(sum(case when r.endedOn > date_sub(now(), interval 60 day) and r.endedOn <= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) and r.resultCategory1=1 and r.resultCategory2=4 then 1 else 0 end)/sum(case when r.endedOn > date_sub(now(), interval 60 day) and r.endedOn <= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) then 1 else 0 end)) then '+' else '' end,round((sum(case when r.endedOn > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) and r.resultCategory1=1 and r.resultCategory2=4 then 1 else 0 end)/sum(case when r.endedOn > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) then 1 else 0 end)-sum(case when r.endedOn > date_sub(now(), interval 60 day) and r.endedOn <= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) and r.resultCategory1=1 and r.resultCategory2=4 then 1 else 0 end)/sum(case when r.endedOn > date_sub(now(), interval 60 day) and r.endedOn <= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) then 1 else 0 end))*100,2),'%') as cnt from Result as r inner join Device as d on d.id = r.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id
